badge: An agent workspace for building a personal brand
heroTitle: Turn what you know into a personal brand people can find.
heroBody: bossip puts topic research, writing and revision in one workspace. Projects hold the context, conversation moves the work, and every change is reviewed before it ships.
ctaNote: No card required · start right away

mock.label: bossip workspace
mock.ask: Turn this week's three interviews into one long post, same voice as last time.
mock.answer: All three interviews circle the same point: you help clients articulate decisions. I moved that up front and grouped the cases by date.

features.title: Projects, not loose chats
features.body: Topics, source material and drafts live in one project, so the next conversation starts with context already loaded.

features.title: The whole process is visible
features.body: Search, file reads, commands and edits — every step opens up to show its input and output.

features.title: Changes get reviewed first
features.body: Every touched line arrives as a diff you approve or reject file by file.

flowTitle: From scattered material to something worth publishing.

steps.title: Create a project and drop your material in
steps.body: Documents, links, old drafts, interview recordings. The project becomes the memory for that thread.

steps.title: Work it in conversation
steps.body: State the goal; the agent plans, researches, writes and revises. You can cut in at any point.

steps.title: Review, then publish
steps.body: Read the diff, run the terminal, preview the page in the side panel, and publish once it holds up.

endBody: Sign up and get going — enough to research, write and revise one long piece.
